2. Pine Crossing: you posted this on 9 Jun 2026. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver can't book trucks. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.

3. Wichita store (may not be Marrow): you posted this on 2 Jul 2025, about an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher. It came right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, but your message doesn't name Marrow, so please confirm.

I left out the Tulsa hub because it's Tansley Parcel's site, not Marrow's.

The list is probably incomplete. On 9 Jun you said three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just say "waiting," and those stores aren't named anywhere in #central-team. Hollis's tracker or your notes from the store ops calls should have them.
